title: DEBRISVERSE
description:
Notice Regarding System EnvironmentDEBRISVERSE includes visual effects and puzzles that utilize features of the Windows OS environment.
For the best and intended experience, playing on a Windows PC is strongly recommended.
(Note: On non-Windows platforms, such as Steam Deck, certain effects or puzzles may not function as intended.)

План развитияMassive Free Update: Sept 2026!! We will continue to evaluate ongoing updates and improvements based on player feedback.[July 29, 2026]• DEBRISVERSE Official Release

• Free Demo Update (Playable up to the completion of the first playthrough)

[Scheduled for September 2026]Major Free UpdateHigh-Difficulty End-Game Content: "Mega Debris Rush (Tentative Title)"

• A wave-survival mode facing waves of powerful boss enemies, "Mega Debris."

• Added hack-and-slash style build crafting: Combine and upgrade boss drops ("Mega Debris Cores") to create your ultimate build.

More details will be revealed soon.

[Future Expansion Concepts (Release Date & Implementation TBD)]We are currently evaluating the following potential features:
(Note: These are not guaranteed updates. Implementation and final specifications will be determined based on player feedback and ongoing development status.)

• Planetary Development: Invest funds to restore environments and gather specialized upgrade materials.

• Cockpit Customization: Decorative features to personalize your cockpit space.

• Codex / Encyclopedia: A dedicated feature to visualize collections and track in-game achievements

Об игреYou owe $100 million.Welcome to DEBRISVERSE.

KEY FEATURES:

• Story-Driven Mystery: Your $100M debt is just the beginning. Hack glitches, decipher hidden codes, and break corporate rules to reach the true ending among 7 distinct outcomes.

• Incremental Mechanics as a Means: Crush space debris and earn credits to unlock access to deeper, more dangerous systems.

• System Hacking & Puzzles: Uncover hidden flags and secret terminals buried within B.R.I.S. Corp’s retro-futuristic interface.

• Nostalgic Sci-Fi Atmosphere: Pixel art, CRT screen noise, and passive-aggressive corporate support from your mascot, Briss.

Your job is simple: crush endless space debris, earn credits, and pay off your astronomical debt.
From the cockpit of your retro-futuristic spaceship, you'll build increasingly powerful tools, watch your earnings explode, and work your way through increasingly dangerous sectors.
But there's something wrong with B.R.I.S. Corporation.
The deeper you go, the more you'll notice strange glitches, hidden systems, and things that shouldn't be there.

Your debt is only the beginning.

[SYSTEM_WARNING: UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS DETECTED]Message from HR:

Our work environment at B.R.I.S. Corp is perfectly safe and compliant.
Rumors concerning "illegal modification patches" and an "endless debt loop" are completely unfounded.
All employees must return to their stations immediately and continue crushing debris.

CRUSH DEBRIS. WATCH THE NUMBERS EXPLODE.Point and click to instantly crush debris with your tools.
The more efficient you become, the more debris floods your screen — and the faster your credits pile up.
Build your destruction power, trigger massive chains, and experience the satisfying rush of watching your numbers spiral out of control.

BUILD YOUR PERFECT DESTRUCTION MACHINEEvery level-up gives you three random upgrades.
Increase your attack power. Boost your credit generation. Create a build that lets you destroy debris faster and faster.
Your choices determine how quickly you can escape your debt.

SPEND YOUR CREDITS OR PAY OFF YOUR DEBTEvery credit has a purpose.
Invest in immediate upgrades to make your tools more powerful, or pay down your debt to unlock discounts on future upgrades.
How you manage your money determines how quickly you can reach your goal.

ENTER MORE DANGEROUS SECTORSAs you pay off your debt, B.R.I.S. Corp grants you access to new Hazardous Sectors.
Denser debris. Bigger targets. Greater risks.
But the more dangerous the sector, the more credits you can earn.

COLLECT MYSTERIOUS FRAGMENTSRare technological remnants can occasionally be found inside the debris.
Collect Fragments to permanently enhance your tools and create the ultimate destruction build.
But these fragments are sending out a mysterious signal.
And you have no idea where it's coming from.

PAYING OFF YOUR DEBT IS ONLY THE BEGINNINGYou've been told what your job is.
But the system is starting to behave strangely.
Glitches appear on your screen. Hidden terminals are waiting to be discovered. Unusual actions outside normal operating procedures may reveal information B.R.I.S. Corp doesn't want you to see.

Sometimes, the only way forward is to stop following the rules.

7 DISTINCT ENDINGSYour actions, choices, and interference with the system can change the course of the story.
Discover hidden flags, uncover the truth behind B.R.I.S. Corp, and find all 7 endings.
Your contract may end.
Your debt may disappear.
But what happens next is up to you.

A NOSTALGIC WORKPLACE IN SPACEExperience your lonely space job through a retro-futuristic interface inspired by old LCD monitors.
Pixel art, screen noise, and a deliberately dated UI create a strange, nostalgic atmosphere as you work your way through the depths of space.
And of course, there's your partner:

Briss.

The official mascot of B.R.I.S. Corp.
Here to provide you with all the strictly administrative support you need.
description_short: A story-driven mystery wrapped in incremental clicker mechanics. Crush space debris to manage your $100M debt, but repayment is merely a cover. Decipher system glitches, hack B.R.I.S. Corp’s dark secrets, and navigate 7 endings to reach the ultimate truth.
